requirements.title: EQUIVALENCE requires a nonempty comma-separated set list
requirements.definition: The keyword is followed directly by one or more equivalence sets. R401 supplies commas between sets. There is no double-colon form or optional set-list branch. Every set separately satisfies R874 and the object constraints.

pending.one-set: PENDING compile/positive-control: complete main program with IMPLICIT NONE, prior ordinary INTEGER i,j, and EQUIVALENCE (i,j) in its specification part. No initialization, value use, TARGET or COMMON complicates admission.
pending.multiple-sets: PENDING compile/positive-control: prior INTEGER i,j,k,l and EQUIVALENCE (i,j),(k,l). The sets have the required separator and do not imply association across the two groups.
pending.missing-set-list: PENDING diagnostic/control: EQUIVALENCE alone in the same complete specification part; append only (i,j) with required token separation. Require an absent-list cause, not incomplete program syntax.
pending.no-double-colon: PENDING diagnostic/control: EQUIVALENCE :: (i,j), repaired by deleting only ::. A spelling allowed by other specification statements is not an R873 alternative.
pending.between-set-comma: PENDING diagnostic/control: EQUIVALENCE (i,j)(k,l), repaired by inserting the comma between two otherwise legal sets. Preserve all four declared eligible objects.
pending.trailing-set-comma: PENDING diagnostic/control: EQUIVALENCE (i,j), at statement end; remove only the final comma. This is not the different case of a missing object inside a set.
pending.scope-order-canonical-plan: PENDING source/placement plan: bind the live statement through R513/R508/R504 to one specification part and actual local entities under19.5.1.4p2(10). C1107 owns BLOCK exclusion; R509/R510 own ordinary executable-part placement. COMMON cross-scope extension stays at8.10.2.2/8.10.3/19.5.3.4. Do not relabel these predicates as R873 token errors or duplicate their cases.

requirements.title: Each set encloses at least two object occurrences
requirements.definition: A set encloses a first object, a required comma and a nonempty R401 list of further objects. The syntactic minimum is therefore two members. Parentheses delimit each set, not a separate outer statement wrapper.

pending.two-object-set: PENDING compile/positive-control: (i,j) for two distinct ordinary local INTEGER scalars, with their declarations and a complete enclosing main program.
pending.three-object-set: PENDING compile/positive-control: (i,j,k) with three distinct local INTEGER scalars. The first member and tail-list members have the same eligibility requirements.
pending.singleton-set: PENDING diagnostic/control: (i), repaired by inserting only ,j before its closing parenthesis; j is already declared and eligible.
pending.empty-tail: PENDING diagnostic/control: (i,), repaired by inserting only the already declared j after the comma.
pending.set-parentheses: PENDING two isolated diagnostic/control pairs omit only the opening or only the closing parenthesis from (i,j). Restore that token alone, leaving all list syntax valid.
pending.object-list-separators: PENDING separate diagnostic/control pairs for (i j) and (i,j,): insert the missing internal comma or remove the trailing internal comma. Keep statement-level separators correct.
pending.object-identity-gate: PENDING source plan: resolve actual objects rather than count spelling occurrences. Controls use distinct objects; repeated names/transitive sets need8.10.1.2/.5 and19.5.3 qualification. Two parsed occurrences alone do not establish two distinct storage sequences or lawful alignment.

requirements.title: Objects are variable names, array elements or substrings
requirements.definition: R903/C903 governs the explicit variable-name alternative, R917/C924 array elements, and R908-R910/C908 substrings. Whole arrays can enter through their variable names. Arbitrary expressions and array sections are not extra alternatives. Base-object, part-reference, constant-index and nonzero-substring restrictions remain separate.

pending.scalar-variable-name: PENDING compile/positive-control: (i,j) with actual mutable local INTEGER scalars. Explicit R903/C903, not assumed R402 or a coincidental spelling, establishes their role.
pending.whole-array-name: PENDING compile/positive-control: prior INTEGER a(2),b(2), then (a,b). Constant shapes and eligible whole names admit the statement;8.10.1.4 owns the first-element effect.
pending.array-element: PENDING compile/positive-control: prior INTEGER a(0:1,3:4),b and (a(0,3),b). Both subscripts are scalar INTEGER constants, in bounds, and select one rank-zero element.
pending.scalar-substring: PENDING separate bounded admissions with CHARACTER(3) c and CHARACTER(2) d: (c(1:2),d), (c(:2),d), or (c(2:),d). Omitted endpoints use9.4.1p3; all substrings are nonzero and in bounds.
pending.array-element-substring: PENDING compile/positive-control: CHARACTER(3) c(2), CHARACTER(1) d and (c(1)(2:2),d). The array index and substring bounds are constants, with one base part-ref.
pending.array-section-not-element: PENDING diagnostic/control: INTEGER a(2),b with (a(1:2),b); repair only to (a(1),b). The rejected designator has positive rank, unlike an element; whole array names remain allowed.
pending.arithmetic-expression-not-object: PENDING diagnostic/control: (i+0,j), repaired by deleting +0 in the ordinary scalar context. A scalar expression is not an equivalence object.
pending.literal-not-variable: PENDING diagnostic/control: (1,j), repaired by replacing1 with predeclared ordinary INTEGER i. A literal is not a variable name, and is not the named-constant base role of C8110.
pending.component-and-constant-owner-plan: PENDING source plan: component elements/substrings can reach this grammar but then meet C8111; named constants also meet C903/C901. Bind the actual grammar alternative and role. Do not invent a unique R875 cause where a numbered object constraint supplies the predicate.
pending.earlier-later-declarations: PENDING bounded admission/source plan: compare INTEGER i,j declarations before and after (i,j), all within the specification part, with no earlier property inquiry/value reference. Also qualify explicitly typed REAL n,m without forcing default INTEGER merely from their initials. EQUIVALENCE has no DATA/PARAMETER-style subsequent-type-confirmation sentence.8.1/8.2/8.7 govern implicit entities; a null mapping does not supply missing types.10.1.12p2 separately requires prior inquiry properties. If an entity is actually used in a specification expression,10.1.11p6 requires prior typing and a later declaration must confirm any implicit type/parameters established there; that condition is not triggered merely by every whole-name EQUIVALENCE occurrence.

requirements.title: Excluded categories are predicates on the base object
requirements.definition: A designator is ineligible when its base is a dummy, function result, pointer, allocatable variable, coarray, automatic object, named constant, BIND variable or member of a BIND common block. Also excluded are nonsequence derived objects, enumeration-type objects and derived objects with any pointer or allocatable ultimate component. These are alternatives, not a conjunction. An element's own attributes do not replace its base's role. Enumeration type and enum type are distinct.

pending.dummy-base: PENDING diagnostic/control: complete non-BIND subroutine s(d) declares INTEGER dummy d and local x,y; (d,x) is repaired only to (y,x). Preserve the dummy header/declaration in both; no call is needed.
pending.function-result-base: PENDING bounded default-result-name and explicit RESULT(r) variants of a complete INTEGER function pair its actual result with local x. Replace that occurrence by predeclared local y. Set the real result to0 in both bodies. Do not name the procedure in a specification statement when RESULT makes it no longer the result (C1570).
pending.pointer-base: PENDING diagnostic/control: scalar INTEGER pointer p and ordinary x in (p,x); remove POINTER for the control without adding TARGET or initialization. Never query association status; an unassociated pointer runtime error is not this static diagnostic.
pending.pointer-array-base: PENDING diagnostic/control: pointer p(:), ordinary a(2),x; replace p(1) by a(1) only. The element lacking POINTER does not remove its forbidden pointer base. Retain the unused valid pointer declaration.
pending.allocatable-base: PENDING diagnostic/control: scalar INTEGER allocatable a and ordinary x; remove ALLOCATABLE only. No allocation, value read or resource outcome enters the static contrast.
pending.allocatable-array-base: PENDING diagnostic/control: allocatable a(:), ordinary b(2),x; replace a(1) by b(1). Allocation cannot make that base eligible; keep the valid unused allocatable declaration in the control.
pending.pointer-ultimate-component: PENDING immediate and nested public SEQUENCE-type diagnostic/control pairs with two objects of the same type and a scalar INTEGER pointer ultimate component. The nested wrapper also has SEQUENCE. Repair the leaf's POINTER attribute to an ordinary scalar, with no initializer. Trace7.5.1p3; all definitions still satisfy C745, without type parameters, type-bound procedures or private identity.
pending.allocatable-ultimate-component: PENDING immediate and nested SEQUENCE-type pairs with a scalar INTEGER allocatable ultimate component. Repair only the leaf's ALLOCATABLE attribute; preserve valid SEQUENCE definitions, ordinary same-type objects and absence of initialization/private components.
pending.nonsequence-derived-base: PENDING diagnostic/control: two objects of one simple public derived type with one INTEGER component. Add SEQUENCE to repair its otherwise C745-conforming definition. Component declaration order alone gives no layout premise to the negative.
pending.enumeration-type-base: PENDING diagnostic/control: define a complete7.6.2 enumeration type and two variables of it, not enumerator constants. Repair their shared declaration to INTEGER, retaining the type definition. Require a forbidden enumeration-base cause, not unsupported syntax.7.6.1 enum types are not this category.
pending.automatic-array-base: PENDING diagnostic/control: subroutine s(n), INTEGER INTENT(IN) n, local INTEGER a(n),b(2), set (a,b). Change only a's bound n to2. Neither equivalenced object is a dummy; no SAVE, initializer or invalid main-program automatic declaration preempts the test.
pending.automatic-character-base: PENDING diagnostic/control: subroutine s(n) has prior nonoptional INTEGER INTENT(IN) dummy n and local CHARACTER(n) a, CHARACTER(2) b. Repair a's length n to2. Its legal nonconstant specification expression creates the forbidden automatic object; unequal fixed lengths are not themselves forbidden.
pending.coarray-base: PENDING diagnostic/control: main-program INTEGER c[*],x with (c,x); remove only [*]. Main-program implicit SAVE satisfies C826 and [*] satisfies R811/C828 before the contrast. Qualify coarray declaration support separately. No image selector, communication or launcher error is evidence here.
pending.bind-variable-base: PENDING diagnostic/control in a complete module: import guaranteed C_INT, declare INTEGER(C_INT),BIND(C) :: c and ordinary INTEGER(C_INT) x; equivalence c,x. Remove BIND(C) only. C819/C820 location/interoperability and equal supported kinds are valid before the contrast; no C call is claimed.
pending.bind-common-member-base: PENDING diagnostic/control: INTEGER(C_INT) c,x; COMMON /blk/ c; BIND(C) :: /blk/; set (c,x). Remove the block's BIND statement only. x adds no storage beyond c and is considered in that block under8.10.2.2. Keep all members interoperable, with no initialization, TARGET or PROTECTED.
pending.named-constant-base: PENDING diagnostic/control: INTEGER,PARAMETER :: k=1 and ordinary x; (k,x). Repair to INTEGER :: k=1 by removing PARAMETER; keep the sole initializer and no duplicate initialized associated unit. C903/C901 can also reject the constant role: record that coupled cause, not exclusive C8110 attribution.
pending.eligible-sequence-boundary: PENDING compile/positive-control: two ordinary objects of one public SEQUENCE type, no pointer/allocatable ultimate component or initialization. Check every C8110 disjunct. A BIND derived type, similar size or direct-components-only check is not a substitute.
pending.enum-and-private-identity-gates: PENDING source-only qualification: C8110 names7.6.2 enumeration objects, not7.6.1 enum objects; all other storage rules still constrain the latter. Do not derive enum/integer value equality from representation. Avoid PRIVATE components rather than closing the pre-existing7.5.2.4 identity question.

requirements.title: An object designator has at most one part-ref
requirements.definition: A component-reference chain is not allowed. This restriction is independent of whether the final form parses as an array element or substring, and whether its whole base is an eligible sequence type.

pending.one-part-element: PENDING compile/positive-control: ordinary INTEGER a(2),b with (a(1),b). The sole part-ref includes an index but no component selection.
pending.component-array-element: PENDING diagnostic/control: public numeric SEQUENCE type with INTEGER a(2), object box and ordinary INTEGER x; (box%a(1),x). Remove only %a(1), making the control (box,x). The whole numeric sequence and its partial association are qualified by19.5.3.4p7; no value is read.
pending.component-substring: PENDING diagnostic/control: public character SEQUENCE type with CHARACTER(2) ch, object box, local CHARACTER(2) c and CHARACTER(1) x. Replace box%ch(1:1) only by c(1:1). Both are otherwise valid nonzero substrings; only the rejected one has two part-refs.

requirements.title: TARGET is excluded including inherited subobject TARGET
requirements.definition: An equivalence object cannot have TARGET.8.5.18p2 supplies this attribute to nonpointer subobjects of a TARGET object; the general fact that array elements do not inherit every array attribute is no exception.

pending.target-scalar: PENDING diagnostic/control: INTEGER,TARGET :: a; ordinary INTEGER b; (a,b). Remove TARGET only. Neither declaration has POINTER.
pending.target-array-element: PENDING diagnostic/control: INTEGER,TARGET :: a(2), ordinary b; (a(1),b). Remove TARGET from a's declaration, leaving its bounds and in-bounds index unchanged.
pending.target-substring: PENDING diagnostic/control: CHARACTER(2),TARGET :: a; CHARACTER(1) b; (a(1:1),b). Remove TARGET only, preserving the legal nonzero substring.

requirements.title: Indices and present substring endpoints are INTEGER constant expressions
requirements.definition: Every subscript and each expression present in a substring range must have INTEGER type and meet 10.1.12. Constant expressions are not limited to literals, and omitted endpoints are not absent required expressions. Array rank, valid bounds and nonzero substring length remain independent conditions.

pending.nonconstant-subscript: PENDING diagnostic/control: INTEGER idx,a(2),b; (a(idx),b). Replace idx by1 only. Initializing idx would not make it a named constant; no variable-value inquiry is the oracle.
pending.nonconstant-substring-start: PENDING diagnostic/control: INTEGER first; CHARACTER(3) a; CHARACTER(2) b; (a(first:2),b). Replace first by1 only, producing an in-bounds nonempty control.
pending.nonconstant-substring-end: PENDING diagnostic/control: INTEGER last; CHARACTER(3) a; CHARACTER(2) b; (a(1:last),b). Replace last by2 only.
pending.named-constant-arithmetic: PENDING compile/positive-control: prior INTEGER,PARAMETER :: k=2, ordinary INTEGER a(3),b, then (a(k-1),b). The prior named constant, intrinsic operation and resulting bound all matter.
pending.fixed-property-inquiry: PENDING admission/source plan: prior CHARACTER(2) c and INTEGER a(3),b; (a(LEN(c)),b).10.1.12p1(6) permits a known-property inquiry without reading c's undefined payload. Bind its prior fixed length and LEN's contract. Moving the declaration later invokes the separate 10.1.12p2 prose/order gate, not an invented C8113-only syntax duty.
pending.omitted-endpoints: PENDING separate admissions for fixed-length c(:2), c(2:) and c(:), with valid compatible peers. Qualify default endpoints under9.4.1p3 and exclude zero-length substrings.
pending.expression-category-and-user-function: PENDING source/diagnostic qualification: REAL indices also violate R919/R910; PURE user functions are not automatically constant expressions. A future user-function negative needs a complete otherwise-valid definition and a literal repair, not a missing interface, later generic definition or wrong-result-type failure.

requirements.title: A listed default numeric-family member constrains the whole set
requirements.definition: Any default INTEGER, default REAL, double precision REAL, default COMPLEX, default LOGICAL or numeric SEQUENCE member requires every member to belong to that type/kind family. Heterogeneous members inside the family are permitted; one common intrinsic type or interchangeable values are not required or implied.

pending.default-integer-trigger: PENDING compile/positive-control: ordinary default INTEGER and default REAL in one set, without initialization or data references. Membership admission is not value reinterpretation.
pending.default-real-trigger: PENDING compile/positive-control: default REAL and default LOGICAL. LOGICAL is explicitly in the family despite not being an arithmetic numeric type; no representation relation is asserted.
pending.double-precision-trigger: PENDING compile/positive-control: DOUBLE PRECISION scalar and default INTEGER scalar. Qualify two versus one numeric storage units and allowed partial association; never read one after defining the other.
pending.default-complex-trigger: PENDING compile/positive-control: default COMPLEX and default REAL scalar. Two-unit storage and partial association stay canonical; part-value observations need a separate19.6 qualification.
pending.default-logical-trigger: PENDING compile/positive-control: default LOGICAL and default INTEGER. Do not impose a truth-bit convention or infer a defined INTEGER value from logical assignment.
pending.numeric-sequence-trigger: PENDING compile/positive-control: public SEQUENCE type with two default INTEGER components, object box, ordinary INTEGER a(2), set (box,a). Resolve recursive numeric sequence classification and all C8110 exclusions, without assumed padding.
pending.outside-family-repair: PENDING diagnostic/control: default INTEGER with default CHARACTER, repaired by changing only the latter declaration to INTEGER. C8114 and C8115 both constrain this mix. Require a family-mismatch cause, not an exclusively printed C8114; any shared witness awaits supported ownership adjudication rather than automatic reuse or duplicate programs.
pending.set-wide-not-first-only: PENDING three-member diagnostic/control: two allowed numeric-family variables followed by a default CHARACTER outsider. Repair its declaration to INTEGER. A bounded permutation can check that the rule is not first-member-only, retaining the coupled-family cause.

requirements.title: Default CHARACTER-family membership applies to every set member
requirements.definition: A default CHARACTER or character-SEQUENCE member requires all members to belong to those categories. Equal lengths and one derived-type identity are not additional conditions here. Eligibility, state and alignment restrictions still apply.

pending.default-character-pair: PENDING compile/positive-control: ordinary default CHARACTER objects of lengths2 and4, using whole names. Unequal length alone is not a violation.
pending.character-sequence-pair: PENDING compile/positive-control: public SEQUENCE type with two default CHARACTER components, its ordinary object and a default CHARACTER peer spanning the same number of character units. No pointer/allocatable component, initialization or private identity is used.
pending.different-character-sequence-types: PENDING bounded admission with two distinct public character SEQUENCE types containing only default CHARACTER components. Qualify each recursive component and allowed overlap; C8116's other-sequence same-type rule does not apply to this family.
pending.foreign-family-repair: PENDING diagnostic/control: character SEQUENCE object and ordinary default INTEGER outsider; replace only the outsider occurrence by a predeclared default CHARACTER peer. Both family constraints can apply. Require a family-specific cause and supported sequence definition; any future multi-owner connection remains pending.

requirements.title: Other sequence types require the same derived type
requirements.definition: If a member has SEQUENCE but is neither numeric SEQUENCE nor character SEQUENCE, all members must have that same derived type. All three premises matter. Similar component lists or storage sizes do not replace type identity under7.5.2.4.

pending.mixed-sequence-same-type: PENDING compile/positive-control: one public SEQUENCE definition with INTEGER and default CHARACTER components, and two ordinary scalar objects of that definition. It is neither family; total same-type association avoids partial-overlap complications.
pending.different-sequence-type: PENDING diagnostic/control: public SEQUENCE types t,u have identical INTEGER/CHARACTER component lists but different type names; associate a of t and b of u. Change b's declaration from u to t only. Retain both valid definitions and avoid PRIVATE components.
pending.every-member-same-type: PENDING three-member diagnostic/control: a,b of mixed type t and c of mixed type u. Repair only c's declaration to t; checking the first pair alone is insufficient.
pending.identity-and-partial-association-gate: PENDING source qualification: use same-definition identity for the finite control. Cross-scope/private identity and partial overlap of mixed sequence structures are not thereby proved.19.5.3.4p7 and the unresolved7.5.2.4 fine unit remain separate gates.

requirements.title: Remaining intrinsic kinds require matching type and KIND
requirements.definition: For an intrinsic member outside the six listed default/double-precision categories, all members must have the same intrinsic type and KIND. A shared kind code does not equate different types. This is not a blanket equal-LEN rule; storage-unit and partial-association restrictions are also necessary.

pending.nondefault-integer-same-kind: PENDING conditional admission: establish a supported INTEGER kind k unequal to KIND(0), then use ordinary INTEGER(k) scalars. SELECTED_INT_KIND(18) is one bounded qualification attempt, not proof that its result differs from default. If no required distinct kind is established, retain PENDING, not invalid-kind execution or fallback success.
pending.nondefault-complex-same-kind: PENDING compile/positive-control: two ordinary COMPLEX(KIND(0.0D0)) scalars.7.4.3.2/.3 establishes the double-precision real kind differs from default and exists for COMPLEX. No numeric ordering of kind codes is assumed.
pending.other-real-logical-kinds: PENDING conditional admission/source plan for at most one additional REAL kind distinct from default and double precision, and one nondefault LOGICAL kind. First bind actual supported parameters; use same-type/kind scalar pairs. Neither extra kind is presumed.
pending.nondefault-character-equal-length: PENDING conditional admission with one supported nondefault CHARACTER kind and two equal fixed-length scalars. Prove its kind differs from KIND('A'); do not use byte widths or encoded character values. Equal lengths avoid an unqualified partial-overlap claim.
pending.different-kind-repair: PENDING conditional diagnostic/control with two independently supported nondefault kinds of one intrinsic type, both outside C8114/C8115's families. Change the second declaration's kind to the first. If unavailable, retain PENDING; unsupported-kind reporting is not C8117 evidence.
pending.same-code-different-type-gate: PENDING source/diagnostic plan: a future unlike-intrinsic-type pair needs individually supported, genuinely equal kind codes and the outside-family premises. Repair the second declaration to the first type/kind. Do not invent such a pair from printed integers or require a numerical ordering of KIND values.
pending.nondefault-character-overlap-gate: PENDING source-only qualification: C8117 requires equal type/KIND, not equal LEN. Unequal-length admission also depends on19.5.3.2p2(4)/(6) and19.5.3.4p7; C character kind need not be default. No unequal-length executable plan is eligible until its actual storage-unit class and total/partial relation are independently established.

requirements.title: A PROTECTED member requires every member to be PROTECTED
requirements.definition: Any PROTECTED equivalence object requires PROTECTED on all members. Unlike SAVE propagation, this is a condition to satisfy, not an attribute automatically conferred by EQUIVALENCE. Module scope, subobject inheritance, USE and COMMON restrictions retain their own owners.

pending.all-protected-module-objects: PENDING compile/positive-control in a complete module specification part: INTEGER,PROTECTED :: a,b; (a,b). Both are locally declared, not imported or in COMMON.
pending.missing-protected-member: PENDING diagnostic/control in that module: protected a but ordinary b; add PROTECTED only to b. Do not move PROTECTED to an invalid subroutine declaration.
pending.three-member-protected-trigger: PENDING diagnostic/control: protected a,b and ordinary c in (a,b,c). Add PROTECTED to c; a bounded permutation checks a trigger away from the first position.
pending.protected-subobject: PENDING diagnostic/control: module INTEGER,PROTECTED :: a(2), ordinary b; (a(1),b). Add PROTECTED to b.8.5.15p3 establishes the element's attribute; neither set uses an imported object.

requirements.oracle: Bounded complete-program-unit admission and diagnostic/control plans under a qualified F2023 profile. Resolve actual objects, declarations, types, kinds, ranks and statement positions before the contrast. Positive compile admission is not a runtime association or value observation.
requirements.oracle_limitation: 4.2 requires capability to detect and report numbered violations, not fatal rejection, a nonzero status, fixed English or a printed rule number. Each future negative needs its stated complete conforming repair and a grammar/entity-specific cause. Unsupported facilities, arbitrary keyword hits, unrelated scope/type errors, source echoes, crashes and resource failures are not corroboration. Stricter rejection policies and diagnostic matchers require explicit qualification. No case or evidence connection is implemented here.

requirements.title: A USE-associated object name is excluded
requirements.definition: The object's name must not be made accessible through USE. Renaming an imported object does not make it local. Importing a type or kind for a separate local declaration is different. EQUIVALENCE's name-locality effect for host entities is resolved under19.5.1.4.

pending.imported-variable: PENDING diagnostic/control: complete provider module exports INTEGER exported; consumer USEs it and declares local INTEGER x,y. Repair (exported,x) only to (y,x). Keep the provider and USE unchanged; no invalid redeclaration or missing module preempts the contrast.
pending.renamed-import: PENDING diagnostic/control: USE provider, ONLY: alias=>exported; repair (alias,x) to (y,x) only. A new local spelling does not change imported identity.
pending.imported-type-local-objects: PENDING compile/positive-control: import one public SEQUENCE type, then declare two actual local objects and equivalence them. Their names remain local; qualify the appropriate numeric/character/other-sequence category independently.
pending.host-locality-source: PENDING source plan:19.5.1.4p2(10) makes a name wholly or partly equivalenced in a contained scope local there, hiding a same-named host entity. Use explicit local declarations and keep the host object separately defined. Merely spelling an inherited name does not equivalence the host's storage; an imported name cannot be repaired by invalid local redeclaration.

requirements.title: An equivalence substring must be nonzero length
requirements.definition: The substring alternative cannot have zero length. Zero-sized storage sequences in general are not banned: a whole zero-length CHARACTER variable or zero-length CHARACTER array element is not a substring occurrence. General endpoint defaults and bounds stay with9.4.1.

pending.reversed-substring-range: PENDING diagnostic/control: CHARACTER(3) c, CHARACTER(1) d; (c(2:1),d), repaired by changing the endpoint1 to2. The negative is a zero-length substring, not an out-of-bounds nonzero substring.
pending.omitted-start-zero-end: PENDING diagnostic/control: c(:0) in that context, repaired only to c(:1). Omitted start means1; the control has length1 and valid bounds.
pending.one-character-substring: PENDING compile/positive-control: (c(1:1),d). The boundary does not require two or more characters.
pending.zero-length-whole-object-boundary: PENDING admission/source plans use CHARACTER(0) z with whole z, or CHARACTER(0) z(1) with array element z(1), not either zero-length substring form. 8.10.1.2/.3 and19.5.3.3 govern their zero storage sequences. Admission alone is no observed alias effect.

requirements.title: Sharing storage does not convert values or transfer array properties
requirements.definition: Different types or type parameters do not trigger conversion or guarantee mathematical equality. The associated objects retain their declarations: a scalar does not acquire array properties, nor does an array become scalar. Value access still needs the definition-state rules of Clause19.

pending.no-conversion-source: PENDING finite source/operation plan for a legal default INTEGER/default REAL set: resolve C8114 and19.5.3, then distinguish association from10.2.1.3 assignment conversion. 19.6.6p1(1) can make the other type undefined after a store. No undefined read, TRANSFER, byte image, consensus or no-op executable establishes this absence of conversion; the source mechanism is pending.
pending.no-mathematical-equality-source: PENDING finite source plan on a qualified heterogeneous set: record type, KIND, unit class and state transitions separately. Absence of an equality guarantee is not an expected unequal value or an assertion permitted to read undefined data.
pending.scalar-array-properties: PENDING future complete runtime parent: INTEGER s,a(2,3), set (s,a); assign all six array elements distinct small literals before any payload use. Check RANK(s)=0, RANK(a)=2, SIZE(a)=6 and s against the independently expected first-element value. Count every guard/completion. RANK/SIZE and8.10.1.4 are prerequisites; inquiry alone does not demonstrate sharing.
pending.character-length-properties: PENDING future property observation tied to the actual defined-character parent at8.10.1.3: LEN2/LEN4 objects retain those lengths while overlapping. Require LEN results2/4 and state-safe character observations. Cross-owner reuse needs future adjudication; do not create a second cloned parent or an unsupported S-runtime link.
pending.declared-type-kind-source: PENDING source/interface plan with supported established parameters: association changes neither declaration nor KIND. Use qualified declarations/inquiries, not code ordering. Define payloads before any value reference or justify an actual fixed-property inquiry. This cannot certify arbitrary representation compatibility.

requirements.oracle: Future complete run/effect parents must observe actual associated objects against independent small INTEGER or default CHARACTER literals. Every referenced subobject must already be defined by justified events. Count reached observations, calls and normal returns where applicable; require exact completion stdout, empty runtime stderr and normal exit. Wrong-expectation and observation-omission sensitivity must preserve required definitions and associations, and follow a fresh passing complete parent.
requirements.oracle_limitation: All plans are pending, not compiler observations or fixture approvals. A source summary, compile-only or no-op success, implementation byte/address layout, TRANSFER, undefined-alias read, arbitrary kind ordering or compiler consensus is not an oracle. Canonical state/type/lifetime premises and any future cross-owner source/interface relationship need explicit adjudication. Existing same-numbered diagnostic/control links do not implement arbitrary S-runtime or positive-only reuse; neither cloned programs nor fictional passing inquiries close that gap.

review_rationale: Independent source review in doc/source_audits/batch_085.json reads all 17 original base units and 84 fine units of 8.10.1.1, verifies every census hash and the 502 global grammar heads, and confirms that R873-R875 and C8110-C8120 reuse the actual numbered identifiers and conditions. C8110 retains all eleven exclusion categories and ultimate-component recursion as alternatives; C8114-C8117 keep the four separate type/kind families; C8118 remains a condition rather than a conferred attribute; C8119 covers use-associated names including renames; C8120 is limited to the substring alternative under 9.4.1 R908-R910. S8.10.1.1-001 records the no-conversion and scalar/array property effect without a diagnostic duty, and the unnumbered note stays informative with its 19.5.3.4 default-initialization cross-reference retained as a dependency. All 95 facets remain pending source plans; no case, execution, oracle, link or fixture approval is created.
